selection_rules.gw: For a single-row GW composition, use that row. For a multi-row composition, select the GW row whose sole authoritative wave parent has the lowest finite GGA(+U) total energy per atom; break an exact displayed-energy tie by smaller stable GW MatDB ID. Never use GW band-gap magnitude.
selection_rules.pbe: Within each normalized composition in the finite PBE/FERE source domain, select the row with the lowest finite total energy per atom; break an exact displayed-energy tie by smaller stable MatDB ID. Do not use PBE or GW gap values.
selection_rules.strict_mapping: Retain a selected GW row only when its normalized composition exists in the PBE/FERE domain and its authoritative GW/wave family anchor is present as exactly one PBE/FERE MatDB row for that composition.
